title: Credential & Trust Verification Centre
subtitle: Antigravity Trust Engine verifying authentic Aadhaar ID, NSDC certificates, and past employer work proofs.

factors.identityDesc: Aadhaar / DigiLocker official identity confirmation (+20 pts)
factors.skillsDesc: Standardized trade assessment or vocational training score (+25 pts)

factors.experienceDesc: Past industrial employer reference or EPF service proof (+20 pts)

auditNotice: All credential verifications follow strict NSDC / NCVT compliance standards.
